n4d8c731845.summary: Gold rose Rs 600 to Rs 1,56,800 per 10 grams in Delhi as a weaker dollar and firm global markets supported demand. Silver was flat.
n4d8c731845.why: India is one of the world's largest gold consumers, and domestic prices reflect both global bullion moves and the rupee's exchange rate.

ne24724c5a5.headline: The 60-day deadline for an Iran peace deal is expiring. Here's where things stand - AOL
ne24724c5a5.summary: A 60-day deadline for an agreement to end the Iran war and resolve the dispute over its nuclear program is expiring. The article outlines where talks stand.
ne24724c5a5.why: Iran's nuclear program and the conflict affecting it are central drivers of Middle East risk premiums in oil and regional assets.

n59704ba7a8.headline: Trump: 'I like the idea of declaring' Strait of Hormuz a US territory
n59704ba7a8.summary: Trump said he liked the idea of declaring the Strait of Hormuz a US territory. Negotiations between the US and Iran broke down more than a month earlier.
n59704ba7a8.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for global oil and LNG shipments, so any change in its control would matter to energy markets.

n8bb0f55f4c.headline: US says Iran talks ‘better than ever’; Tehran calls claim a ‘fantasy’
n8bb0f55f4c.summary: Jared Kushner said US contacts with parts of Iran's regime were better than ever, while the IRGC denied any talks were taking place. Trump said US pressure and the Hormuz blockade have left Iran in big trouble.
n8bb0f55f4c.why: Negotiations between the US and Iran affect oil supply through the Strait of Hormuz and the sanctions regime, which feed into global energy prices.

n9140fdda00.headline: Yes Bank makes bond market comeback years after AT1 write-off
n9140fdda00.summary: Yes Bank is re-entering the bond market with a new three-year US dollar-denominated note, years after an AT1 write-off.
n9140fdda00.why: Yes Bank is a private Indian lender whose return to international debt markets signals improved access to funding after its earlier troubles.

ne8cedc330b.headline: Trump says Hormuz 'new US territory', no talks planned
ne8cedc330b.summary: Trump said no talks with Iran are under way or scheduled and posted a map showing the Strait of Hormuz as new American territory.
ne8cedc330b.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so statements on its status affect energy-market risk.

n6185c74874.headline: Saatvik Solar inks MoU with Odisha for 3.6 GW solar cell manufacturing facility
n6185c74874.summary: Saatvik Solar has signed an MoU with the Indian state of Odisha to set up a 3.6 GW solar cell manufacturing facility. The project is expected to boost local employment and industrial growth.
n6185c74874.why: Saatvik Solar is an Indian solar module maker, and large domestic cell factories shape supply in India's renewable energy push.

ne0b9e146cf.headline: Japan's 10-year bond yield hits 30-year high as growth data misses
ne0b9e146cf.summary: Japan's 10-year government bond yield climbed to its highest level since 1996 on Monday. Fresh data showed the economy grew far more slowly than expected in the second quarter.
ne0b9e146cf.why: Japan's 10-year government bond yield is the benchmark for long-term yen borrowing costs and is closely watched by global bond investors.
ne0b9e146cf.why_moved: Weaker-than-expected second-quarter growth data pushed Japanese government bond yields to their highest level since 1996.

n4733aa0a86.headline: Pakistan refiner Cnergyico expands US crude imports amid Hormuz disruption
n4733aa0a86.summary: Cnergyico is seeking to diversify supplies after disruption in the Strait of Hormuz and could use a proposed US EXIM trade-finance facility. Its chair cited a $1.2 billion upgrade including a second offshore mooring.
n4733aa0a86.why: Cnergyico is a Pakistani oil refiner, so changes in its crude sourcing reflect shifts in global supply routes and import costs.

nff7ed4eecd.headline: India set for record soyoil imports as Russia-Ukraine war disrupts sunflower shipments
nff7ed4eecd.summary: India's soyoil imports surged to a record 620,000 tons in August. The rise followed disruptions to sunflower oil shipments caused by the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
nff7ed4eecd.why: India is one of the world's largest edible oil importers, and it substitutes soyoil when sunflower oil supplies fall. Its import volumes affect global vegetable oil prices.

n1e02a4cd35.headline: Trump Warns Oman Amid Iran Strait Talks
n1e02a4cd35.summary: President Trump has threatened military action against Oman if it interferes with US negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz. The warning comes as the US-Iran memorandum of understanding nears expiration.
n1e02a4cd35.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key transit route for a large share of seaborne oil, so disputes over its reopening can move global energy prices and shipping costs.
n1e02a4cd35.why_moved: Tensions over reopening the Strait of Hormuz raise fears of disrupted oil transit, which feeds into crude prices and energy equities.

n46104936f1.headline: Nike Falls 3% to a Fresh 52-Week Low as China Weakness Overshadows Its Wholesale Rebound
n46104936f1.summary: Nike hit a fresh 52-week low even as its wholesale numbers improved, with China weakness overshadowing the rebound, according to the article.
n46104936f1.why: Nike is a global athletic footwear and apparel company, and China is a major sales market for it. Analysts' views on wholesale trends shape expectations for its growth.
n46104936f1.why_moved: The article ties the decline to China weakness, which overshadowed improving wholesale numbers.

nf7c9fecba8.headline: Druckenmiller dumps Micron, Intel, buys Amazon in Q2 2026
nf7c9fecba8.summary: Druckenmiller's family office increased its Amazon stake by more than 1,000% in Q2 2026 while completely exiting Broadcom, Intel and Micron, according to Yahoo Finance.
nf7c9fecba8.why: Druckenmiller Family Office is a major investment vehicle, and its quarterly 13F filings reveal the holdings changes of a prominent investor.

n30a066cd69.headline: AXT Soars Again on Monday to Lead Optics Stocks. Coherent and Lumentum Rally on Indium Phosphide Price Hikes
n30a066cd69.summary: A Taipei supply report on indium phosphide price increases lifted optics stocks, with AXT leading gains and Coherent and Lumentum rallying. The report sent shockwaves through the optics sector on Monday.
n30a066cd69.why: Indium phosphide is a compound semiconductor material used in optical components, so its input costs affect optics and laser makers.

ncde8874580.headline: Silver deficit vs Gold’s central banks: Which precious metal has the stronger demand story? - BusinessToday
ncde8874580.summary: Central-bank buying supports gold while industrial consumption drives silver's demand case. Tata Mutual Fund expects silver to stay in deficit for a sixth consecutive year in 2026.
ncde8874580.why: Gold and silver are major precious metals; gold is widely held as a reserve asset, while silver has substantial industrial demand.

impacts.why: A projected multi-year deficit and industrial demand support the silver market balance.

na1e53732e7.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and GDP growth data shape expectations for domestic demand, central bank policy and capital flows into the country.

n25429ccac8.headline: Chandrasekaran, Noel Tata separately briefed govt on rift, concerns before chairman
n25429ccac8.summary: Tata leaders separately updated government officials on internal conflicts and strategic rifts within the conglomerate. Discussions covered business initiatives, appointments and Air India's financial woes.
n25429ccac8.why: Tata Group is one of India's largest conglomerates, spanning autos, steel, software and aviation, so governance disputes at its top level matter to investors.

n5139542d70.headline: Gold steady near US$4,400 as traders weigh US data, rate path
n5139542d70.summary: Gold held steady near US$4,400 an ounce as traders weighed US data and the rate outlook. Recent gains were supported by investor appetite and central bank buying, notably from China.
n5139542d70.why: Gold is a benchmark safe-haven and reserve asset, and its price is sensitive to real interest rates and the US dollar.

ne210ca618c.why: The FBM KLCI is the benchmark index of Malaysia's main equity market, tracking the largest listed companies on Bursa Malaysia.

nbb962aa3ae.headline: AirAsia Posts RM527 Million Q2 Loss, Plans To Cut Seat Capacity By Up To 25%
nbb962aa3ae.summary: AirAsia Group posted a net loss of RM527.16 million in the second quarter of its 2026 financial year, driven by higher fuel costs and forex losses. It plans to cut seat capacity by up to 25%.
nbb962aa3ae.why: AirAsia is a Malaysian low-cost airline group, and fuel and currency costs are major drivers of earnings in the airline sector.

nfb8ae97c27.headline: China retail sales disappoint in July, industrial output slows while new home prices extend declines
nfb8ae97c27.summary: China's July retail sales disappointed, industrial output slowed and new home prices extended declines. The data release was delayed to the end of domestic trading.
nfb8ae97c27.why: China's consumption, factory output and property prices are key gauges of the world's second-largest economy and its demand for commodities.
nfb8ae97c27.why_moved: The report showed weak retail sales, slower industrial output and falling new home prices, and its release was delayed to the end of domestic trading.

n8c73546cc6.headline: Bain-backed Dhoot Transmission jumps in market debut, valued at $2.5 bn
n8c73546cc6.summary: Bain Capital-backed Dhoot Transmission rose as much as 38.3% in its India trading debut on Monday, giving the company a valuation of about $2.5 billion.
n8c73546cc6.why: Bain Capital is a global private equity firm, and successful Indian listings return value to investors after private backing.

n816011a436.headline: How much income tax salaried class paid in July 2026?
n816011a436.summary: The Federal Board of Revenue collected Rs44 billion in income tax from the salaried class during July, the first month of the fiscal year.
n816011a436.why: The FBR is Pakistan's tax authority, and its collections are a key measure of fiscal revenue tracked by investors and the IMF.

n479f0b2756.why: Mesa Laboratories makes precision instruments and quality-control products for life sciences and industrial customers, and its debt levels matter to investors.

nc9cbac21b9.headline: Anthropic revenue run rate tops $65 billion, source says
nc9cbac21b9.summary: Anthropic shared its latest revenue run-rate figure with investors, a source said. The growth reflects strong enterprise demand for its Claude coding agent, and the company confidentially filed for an IPO earlier this year.
nc9cbac21b9.why: Anthropic is an AI developer whose models compete with OpenAI, and its revenue and IPO plans are closely watched as a benchmark for the AI sector.
